page.overview:
What is Bob the Builder?

Bob the Builder was a DUPLO and Explore licensed theme based on the British children's television series of the same name by HiT Entertainment (currently known as Mattel Television) and Keith Chapman. The theme ran for eight years, thus making it one of the longest running DUPLO subthemes. Many sets were based on the vehicle characters seen in the show, but some included 3 DUPLO Figures (Bob, Wendy and Spud).
